title: Formal plane-equation calculation of the adjunction lattice
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field. Let $S$ be a reduced finite-type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], with $\operatorname{Spec}S$ pure of dimension $1$ [def-weil-pure-dimension] and a local complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Let $\mathfrak m$ be a maximal ideal with residue field $k$, put $A=S_{\mathfrak m}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and let $K_A$ be the stalk of the adjunction line of [lem-trf-flat-lci-canonical-adjunction]. Write $Q(A)$ for $A$ with all non-zero-divisors inverted and $B\subset Q(A)$ for its integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Let $D=B_{\mathfrak n}$ at a maximal ideal over $\mathfrak m$, and assume that $D$ is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], is essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra], has residue field $k$, and is the local ring of a smooth curve [def-sc-curves]. Let $F$ be its fraction field. On the generic point of this branch the smooth-locus identification of the adjunction line defines an isomorphism $K_A\otimes_A F\cong\Omega^1_{F/k}$, where differentials are [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials].

Suppose an isomorphism of complete local $k$-algebras $\widehat A\cong k[[x,y]]/(f)$ is given, where $f\neq0$ belongs to $(x,y)$ and this quotient is reduced; completion is maximal-ideal-adic [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] and formal power series are [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Choose a complete local $k$-algebra isomorphism $\widehat D\cong k[[t]]$; the map $\widehat A\to\widehat D$ gives $x=x(t)$ and $y=y(t)$. Assume the images of $f_x=\partial f/\partial x$ and $f_y=\partial f/\partial y$ in $k[[t]]$ are not both zero. Formal differentiation means $\mathrm d(\sum a_nt^n)=\sum n a_nt^{n-1}\mathrm dt$, extended to $k((t))$ by the quotient rule; the partial derivatives are defined coefficientwise in the same way. Under the map of rational differentials $\Omega^1_{F/k}\to k((t))\mathrm dt$ induced by $F\hookrightarrow k((t))$, the image of the completed $D$-span $(K_A\otimes_A D)\otimes_D k[[t]]$ (extension of scalars [def-weil-module-base-change]) is the free rank-one $k[[t]]$-lattice generated by
$$
 r=\frac{x'(t)\,\mathrm dt}{f_y(x(t),y(t))}\quad\text{if }f_y(x(t),y(t))\neq0,
 \qquad
 r=-\frac{y'(t)\,\mathrm dt}{f_x(x(t),y(t))}\quad\text{if }f_x(x(t),y(t))\neq0.
$$
The formulas agree when both denominators are nonzero. In this comparison the completed regular-differential module $\Omega^1_{D/k}\otimes_D k[[t]]$ is $k[[t]]\mathrm dt$. The lattice is compared through the given generic smooth-locus identification; thus it is independent of the chosen algebraic presentation, the formal equation, and the formal parameter.
